After You Enquire

What to Expect

Here is exactly what happens after you call or submit a quote request.

01
We Acknowledge

You receive confirmation within 2–4 hours during business hours. Horacio personally reviews every enquiry.

02
Site Visit Arranged

A Vuka team member visits your site within 48 hours to assess scope, measure, and understand your requirements.

03
Written Quote Issued

An itemised written quotation is issued within 24 hours of the site visit. No verbal quotes, no lump sums.

04
Work Begins

On acceptance, a start date is confirmed. We mobilise on the agreed day, and Horacio is reachable throughout.

Common Questions

Quote & Project FAQ

Pricing depends on area size, access conditions, surface condition, specification, and location. We do not publish rates because a rate per m² without a site inspection is meaningless — it leads to surprises. Every Vuka quote is based on an actual site visit. Call 073 916 2947 to arrange yours.
Yes, ideally. Having you present means we can understand your brief, ask questions, and ensure the quote addresses exactly what you need. If you cannot be present, arrange for someone who knows the project to meet us.
Most residential site visits take 20–40 minutes. Commercial or industrial site assessments may take 1–2 hours depending on complexity. We do not rush site visits — a complete assessment produces a more accurate quote.
Yes. We do not charge for site visits or written quotations. There is no pressure to accept. We provide accurate quotes because that is how we build trust — not by locking clients in with low estimates and adding variations later.
We do not have a formal minimum project size. Call and describe what you need — if it is something we can assist with, we will tell you. If it is too small for us to mobilise cost-effectively, we will tell you that too, honestly.
